decisions.decision: Use k-leumas/homebrew-tap (tap name: k-leumas/tap) as the single canonical tap for all tools
decisions.rationale: homebrew-queque was a renamed version of homebrew-tap — same repo, two names, caused brew install conflict. General tap scales better for future tools.

decisions.decision: qq init zsh outputs source line instead of inlining full script
decisions.rationale: Inlining 200+ lines into .zshrc is hostile UX. Source line is one line, stays current when file is updated.

decisions.decision: Homebrew install copies queque.zsh to $(brew --prefix)/share/queque/ — init.ts checks this path first
decisions.rationale: Homebrew Cellar paths include version number and go stale after brew upgrade. share/ is stable and version-agnostic.

decisions.decision: init.ts detects Homebrew by checking known prefixes (/opt/homebrew, /usr/local, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew) — no subprocess
decisions.rationale: Zero-cost detection at init time. brew --prefix spawn would be slower and less portable.

decisions.decision: Wolf files always committed via --amend --no-edit when they are the only change
decisions.rationale: Wolf files mirror their corresponding code changes and must never be a separate commit.
